description.value: This study investigated regional gray matter volume associations with cerebrovascular risk factors in men and women in a healthy community-dwelling cohort aged 60–64 years using optimized voxel-based morphometry.
A cross-sectional observational MRI study of community-dwelling adults aged 60–64 years, sampled from the PATH Through Life Project.

spans.text: Subjects were sampled from the 60- to 64-year-old group in the PATH Through Life Project, which is a longitudinal study of three cohorts aged 20–24, 40–44 and 60–64 years, all composed of community residents recruited randomly through electoral rolls from the city of Canberra and the adjacent town of Queanbeyan, Australia.
